1. Read the hook-related code to confirm what the guard refuses. `packages/cli/src/commands/hook.ts` has `guardReason` and the `gitReason` around lines 327-378, and the Bash write checks. The guard refuses edits to `.factory/**`, edits to the primary checkout on the default branch, shell commands that write those paths (redirects, tee, cp, mv, rm, sed -i), and in a factory repo a force push or remote delete, `git reset --hard`, `git clean -f` and `git branch -D`. Don't change hook.ts.

2. In `packages/cli/src/cli.ts`, rewrite only the `.description(...)` of `hook.command("guard")` as one plain sentence covering all of it. Suggested text: "PreToolUse: refuse edits to .factory/** and to the primary checkout on the default branch, shell commands that write them, and in a factory repo a force push or remote delete, git reset --hard, git clean -f and git branch -D". Leave the `.action` and every other command as they are.

3. Add the new test file `packages/cli/src/cli.test.ts` (vitest, same style as `commands/hook.test.ts`). Import `buildProgram` from `./cli.js`. Find `hook` and then `guard` with `program.commands.find(c => c.name() === ...)`. Get `helpInformation()` and collapse whitespace (`.replace(/\s+/g, " ")`), because Commander wraps long descriptions. Covers A1: the guard's help contains `.factory/**`, `primary checkout on the default branch`, `force push`, `git reset --hard`, `git clean -f` and `git branch -D`.

4. In the same test file, cover A2: the collapsed `helpInformation()` of the `hook` command has a `guard` entry whose text contains the guard command's `description()`, collapsed the same way. Don't edit `packages/cli/src/commands/hook.test.ts` or any other existing test (A3).

5. Add `.changeset/guard-help-text.md` with `"@arynbht/factory": patch`. In one plain sentence, say that `factory hook guard --help` and `factory hook --help` now name everything the guard refuses, including shell writes and the destructive git commands, so someone whose git command was refused can tell it came from the guard. Say the guard's behaviour is unchanged.
6. Run `pnpm action:build` and commit the rebuilt `packages/action/dist/`. AGENTS.md requires this for any change under packages/cli, or CI's bundle check fails.

7. Run `pnpm run lint`, `pnpm run typecheck` and `pnpm run test`, or at least `pnpm --filter @arynbht/factory test`. Confirm the new cli.test.ts passes and the existing hook.test.ts passes unchanged, which is A3. Check `git diff --stat` to make sure only cli.ts, the new cli.test.ts, the changeset and `packages/action/dist/**` changed.
